modern: The idle business of show, plays on the stage, flocks of sheep, herds, exercises with spears, a bone thrown to little dogs, a bit of bread tossed into fishponds, the labours of ants and their burden-carrying, the scurrying about of frightened little mice, puppets pulled by strings—all alike. It is your duty, then, in the midst of such things to show good humour and not a proud air; but to understand that every man is worth just as much as the things he busies himself about.
original: The idle business of show, plays on the stage, flocks of sheep, herds, exercises with spears, a bone cast to little dogs, a bit of bread into fishponds, laborings of ants and burden-carrying, runnings about of frightened little mice, puppets pulled by strings—[all alike]. It is thy duty then in the midst of such things to show good humor and not a proud air; to understand however that every man is worth just so much as the things are worth about which he busies himself.
